issues.failure_explanation: The paper claims the serendipity edge/node spaces are H(curl)/H^1-conforming with boundary continuity preserved. But in the serendipity edge space the face DoFs [2] (moments of the tangential trace against x_F p for degrees beta_d+1..beta_d') are reduced (the original space has beta' primed, so edge DoFs may even be reduced), and by (eqdefvs) their values are set equal to those of Pi^S v = Pi_m v, the L^2 projection over the element K. For a face F shared by K and K', the two elements assign the reduced tangential-trace moments via different element-wise projections Pi_m^K v and Pi_m^{K'} v, so the tangential trace of a global function is not single-valued across F. The same happens for reduced face DoFs [3] of the node space (H^1-conformity). Conformity, and hence the exact-sequence and B-compatibility claims, are therefore unsupported for the spaces as defined.

issues.failure_explanation: S-identifying only means the preserved DoFs are injective on S. The L^2 projection onto S requires the moments (v,p) for all p in S, which are not in general functions of the preserved DoFs alone (the DoF-based form D^T G D with G the Gram matrix of preserved Lagrange bases is not the L^2 inner product, since v also has reduced-DoF components). E.g. for the edge space, identifying P^3_m may hold with mu_r = m-2, k_d = m-2, yet computing Pi_m v needs DoF [4] up to order m and [5] up to m-1 (cf. propcompoly). In such cases the reduced DoFs in (eqdefvs) are not determined by the preserved DoFs and V^S is not well defined with those DoFs.

issues.failure_explanation: The proof of [2] only checks the standard face DoFs [1],[2] (normal trace, divergence). For the serendipity spaces one must also match the reduced face DoFs [3]: for v in V^{Se}, (curl v, x×p) for reduced p equals (curl Pi_m v, x×p), whereas I^{Sf}(curl v) would carry (Pi^S curl v, x×p) with Pi^S an L^2 projection onto the face-side S; curl Pi_m v is not the L^2 projection of curl v onto curl P^3_m, so the two interpolants differ in general. Moreover the range space curl V^{Se} is the divergence-free face space V^f_{(m-1,-1,mu_r)}, which for m>=2 contains no P^3_{m'} with m'>=1 and does not fit the serendipity face definition (k_d = m-1) nor the hypothesis P^3_m ⊆ V^{Sf} of thmvf. The same gap applies to [3] (grad V^{Sn} vs V^{Se}, Pi_{m-1} grad v ≠ grad Pi_m v). Consequently the exact sequence of serendipity spaces and eqcomm [2],[3] are unsupported.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: No complete source-supported repair identified; at minimum, a repair must define the range spaces curl V^{Se}, grad V^{Sn} precisely (their reduced DoFs are fixed by curl Pi_m v, grad Pi_m v rather than by an L^2 serendipity projection), prove the commuting identities for those spaces including the reduced DoFs, and re-derive the curl/grad interpolation estimates without invoking thmvf/thmve on spaces that do not satisfy their hypotheses.

issues.failure_explanation: The basis functions psi_i^l live in V^S_l, which changes with l (the original space V_l grows), so ||Pi_l psi_i^l|| is not a monotone sequence of projections of a fixed function; the limit object psi_i^∞ is undefined, and the density argument is not available. Full row rank of M^l does not follow from linear independence of {psi_i^l} in L^2 for a fixed l: a nonzero combination w_l = Σ c_i psi_i^l could be L^2-orthogonal to P^3_l for every l. The stability bound cited from [daveiga] (77,105) has constants depending on the polynomial degree, so C_K is not l-uniform as used. Finally, even if injectivity of Pi_l on V^S_l were shown, the concluding 'norm equivalence on a finite dimensional space' yields only element-dependent constants, whereas stabilization-free coercivity requires ||Pi_l v|| ≈ ||v|| with constants uniform in h and shape (Assumption assmesh); nothing in the paper provides this.
